Shell(git commit -- src tests docs README.md SPEC.md STATE.md package.json tsconfig.json -F - <<'EOF' Production readiness: Finance Act 2025 CGT, persona council, zero-capital inference Tax correctness: - Rebuild CGT to be acquisition-date-aware per the NCCPL / Finance Act 2025 structure: flat 15% for acquisitions on/after 1 Jul 2024, progressive 12.5% -> 0% for Jul 2022 - Jun 2024, exempt before Jul 2013. The previous implementation applied the pre-2024 slab using holding days alone, and the SPEC's own "held 1500 days -> 0%" acceptance test was wrong. - Add purchase_date to holdings (guarded migration) so the tranche can be determined; capture it when adding a holding. - Parameterize FIRE (inflation + withdrawal rate) and devaluation (USD rate). - Record provenance and confidence caveats in docs/TAX-RULES.md. Zero-capital inference: - Provider chain with automatic fallback on failure or rate limit: Gemini free tier, Groq free tier, OpenRouter, then user BYOK. - 24-hour on-device response cache, so repeat questions cost no tokens. - Per-provider key and model management in Settings. Advisory depth: - Six personas with a deterministic scored router, an Auto mode, and an opt-in Council debate (two personas plus a synthesis pass). - enforceNoDirective() scans every reply for buy/sell directives and appends a correction: Principle XVI enforced in code, not just in the prompt. Fixes: - PIN removal no longer leaves the app permanently unopenable; PIN moved to SecureStore with failed-attempt throttling. - Dashboard FIRE progress read from a value that was never assigned and so always showed 0%; it now uses real net worth and honours the saved target. - PSX price fetch gains a fallback host, never overwrites a good price with a failure, and labels stale quotes instead of presenting them as live. Tests: - 38 unit tests on Node's built-in runner (no new dependencies) covering every CGT tranche boundary, FIRE, SIP, ROI, the persona router and the guard. Docs: STATE.md handover note; docs/TAX-RULES.md, SECP-POSTURE.md, DATA-SOURCES.md, BETA-LAUNCH-POST.md; README and SPEC corrected. Co-authored-by: CommandCodeBot <noreply@commandcode.ai> EOF)
